title: 49 Essential Small Business Stats You Need to Know

facts.fact: According to the SBA (2023), 99.9% of American businesses are small businesses.
facts.quote: Most businesses are small — 99.9% of American businesses.

facts.fact: According to the SBA (2023), small businesses pay 39.4% of the private sector payroll.
facts.quote: Small businesses pay 39.4% of the private sector payroll.

facts.fact: According to the SBA (2023), there are 33 million small businesses in the United States.
facts.quote: There are 33 million small businesses in the United States.

facts.fact: According to the SBA (2023), small businesses created 17.3 million net new jobs from 1995 to 2021, accounting for 62.7% of net jobs created since 1995.
facts.quote: From 1995 to 2021, small businesses created 17.3 million net new jobs, accounting for 62.7% of net jobs created since 1995.

facts.fact: According to Guidant Financial (2023), 28% of business owners primarily go into business because they are 'ready to be their own boss'.
facts.quote: Business owners primarily go into business because they are “ready to be their own boss” (28%)

facts.fact: According to Guidant Financial (2023), 23% of business owners primarily go into business due to overall dissatisfaction with corporate America.
According to the SBA (2023), small businesses generate 32.6% of known export value.
facts.quote: Small businesses generate 32.6% of known export value.

facts.fact: According to the SBA (2023), small businesses employ 61.7 million Americans, which equals 46.4% of private sector employees.
facts.quote: Small businesses employ 61.7 million Americans, which equals 46.4% of private sector employees.

facts.fact: According to the SBA (2023), about 38% of small businesses use specialized software in their business operations.
facts.quote: About 38% of small businesses use specialized software in their business operations.

facts.fact: According to Guidant Financial (2023), Baby Boomers (39.63%) and Gen X (47.20%) make up the majority of small business owners.
facts.quote: Baby Boomers (39.63%) and Gen X (47.20%) make up the majority of small business owners.

facts.fact: According to Forbes (2023), females own 43.2% of small businesses.
facts.quote: Females only own 43.2% of small businesses.

facts.fact: According to Forbes (2023), racial minorities own 19.4% of small businesses.
facts.quote: Racial minorities own 19.4% of small businesses.

facts.fact: According to Guidant Financial (2023), over 70% of small business owners feel satisfied as business owners, with 37% 'very happy' and 35% 'somewhat happy'.
facts.quote: Over 70% of small business owners feel satisfied as business owners, with 37% feeling “very happy” and 35% feeling “somewhat happy.”

facts.fact: The page states that the fastest-growing industries are healthcare and social assistance, citing Forbes (2023).
facts.quote: The fastest-growing industries are healthcare and social assistance.

facts.fact: The page reports that the closure rate in the transportation and storage sector fell by 8% from 21% to 13% in 2022, the largest decrease in closures it observed; the source for this figure is not visible in the captured text.
facts.quote: The largest decrease in closures was observed in the transportation and storage sector, where the rate of closure fell by 8% from 21% to 13% in 2022
